from.place: The finite Koszul model of derived completion in def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback; Tag 0A0E identifies the negative finite complex with the dual of the positive one. This node isolates splitting off the first exterior koszul generator. This node isolates explicit graded head-tail exterior multiplication.

title: Explicit graded head-tail exterior multiplication
statement: For a commutative ring A and r natural, take a coefficient list a : Fin(r+1) to A and a natural power index m, and form completedKoszulPower of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Exterior powers and their multiplication are those of [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. The head inclusion sends the unique standard generator of A to e_0 in A^(r+1), and the tail inclusion sends e_i to e_(i+1). In exterior degrees n and k, koszulJoinWedge sends x tensor y to the product of their exterior images in degree n+k. For cochain degrees p,q with p+q=i, koszulJoinSummand is zero if p or q is positive; otherwise conjugate that wedge map by the extension isomorphisms of the specified head, tail, and full complexes in exterior degrees -p,-q,-i. Coefficients and m are explicit arguments so that none of the types requires identifying the complex with one having different coefficients. The map koszulJoinGraded from the degree-i coproduct of the total tensor [def-weil-pbc-finite-negative-koszul-tensor] is induced by these explicit summand maps. No existence theorem is used to choose data.

lean.statement:
def koszulJoinGraded (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) (m : ℕ) (i : ℤ) :
    (HomologicalComplex.tensorObj
      (completedKoszulPower (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m)
      (completedKoszulPower (A := A) r (fun j ↦ a j.succ) m)).X i ⟶
        (completedKoszulPower (A := A) (r + 1) a m).X i
